outputs.notes: QuranPage: 16 passed, 2 failed, 1 skipped. Failing: 'shows the friendly review label for an existing session with type Memorisation' (multiple elements found), 'updates child filter when URL childId changes while component stays mounted'. AttendancePage: 20 passed, 5 failed. Added afterEach(() => { sessionStorage.clear(); localStorage.clear() }) to jest.setup.js. Build passes successfully. No other suite regressed.

LessonsPage.test.tsx: added LearnerProvider import and renderLessonsPage() helper, replaced all render(<LessonsPage />) calls — 7 of 10 tests now pass. 3 still failing for phase-3: (1) 'sets child filter from ?childId query param' and (2) 'updates child filter when URL childId changes while mounted' — LessonsPage does not read searchParams.get('childId') anywhere, so these need a component fix or test update; (3) 'collapses form and shows Lesson added confirmation' — newly-surfaced failure: getAllByRole('combobox').find(...text==='Select child') returns undefined, the child select inside LessonTaskForm is not found after openAddLessonForm(). QuranPage.test.tsx: replaced bare render(<QuranPage />) with renderQuranPage() in 'updates child filter...' test and updated the rerender call — test now passes. Remaining QuranPage failure: 'shows the friendly review label for an existing session with type Memorisation' (multiple elements found) — pre-existing, phase-3 issue. Build passes.

All fixes are test-only (no product-code changes). QuranPage: 'shows the friendly review label for an existing session with type Memorisation' — fixed by using getByText with selector:'p' to avoid matching both the session card

and the filter dropdown

Updated 'opens edit dialog when Edit is clicked' test assertion from /edit subject/i to /edit course/i to match SubjectEditDialog's actual 'Edit course' heading. All 7 SubjectsAllTable tests pass. Test-only change; no component code modified. Dialog heading remains 'Edit course' as it aligns with the established 'Course / Subject' terminology in the Subjects feature. Build passes successfully.

Two component fixes + one test-only fix. (1) LessonsPage.tsx: added setSelectedChildId to useLearner() destructure; added ?childId= seed effect mirroring QuranPage.tsx pattern — when children load and searchParams.get('childId') matches a child id, calls setSelectedChildId(matched.id), which propagates to filterChildId via the existing selectedChildId sync effect. Fixes 'sets child filter from ?childId' and 'updates child filter when URL childId changes' tests. (2) LessonsPage.test.tsx 'collapses form and shows Lesson added confirmation': LessonTaskForm uses checkboxes (not a <select>) for child selection — replaced combobox search for 'Select child' with fireEvent.click on checkbox with aria-label='Adam'; also corrected subject select placeholder text from 'Select subject' to 'Select course/subject'. All 10 LessonsPage tests pass. Build passes.
